answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to destroy a specific native token to gain network access. By treating the token as a finite nectar for operational participation, the system forces an attacker to incur a hard cost for every additional vertex they create in the graph. This economic constraint ensures that each identity is as costly to forge as cracking a walnut, effectively preventing an adversary from overwhelming the consensus without depleting their own capital.
